page.notes: The left edge of the scan shows text of the neighbouring page (fragments such as "17.", "eft", "nitę"); it is not transcribed. The superscript mark in "fatente s Cardinale" is read as s, but the margin note beside that line carries the mark t; the two could not be reconciled from the scan, so the text mark is given as {s} and the note as letter "t". The opening word "dum:" is a fragment carried over from the previous page. The first paragraph is continued (cont="true"). Italic is read from the scan: "Dua sunt", the following sentence, and the passage from "Theologi Lovanienses" to "satisfactiones." Ligatures pœ and æ were read as printed.
